SELECT json_object(
'events', COALESCE((
SELECT json_group_array(json(event_data)) FROM (
'id', areas.id,
'announcement_id', areas.announcement_id,
'event_image', areas.event_image_path || areas.id || '.png',
'banner_image', areas.banner_image_path || areas.id || '.png',
'listbutton_image', areas.listbutton_image_path || areas.id || '.png',
'recommend', null,
'lock', null,
'start_at', area_availables.start_at,
'end_at', area_availables.end_at,
'wday', (
SELECT json_group_array(area_availables.wday)
FROM area_availables
WHERE area_availables.area_id = areas.id
'wday_start_at', areas.wday_start_at,
'wday_end_at', areas.wday_end_at,
'quests', (
SELECT json_group_array(
json_object(
'id', quests.id,
'name', quests.name,
'visit_count_max', quests.visit_count_max,
'interval_reset_visited_days', quests.interval_reset_visited_days,
'limitations', (
'id', quest_limitations.id,
'type', quest_limitations.type,
'description', quest_limitations.description,
'conditions', json(quest_limitations.conditions)
FROM quest_limitations
WHERE quest_limitations.quest_id = quests.id
'user_quest', (
'visited_count', 1,
'next_reset_at', 0
FROM quests
WHERE quests.area_id = areas.id AND quests.start_at < ?
'priority', area_availables.priority
) AS event_data
FROM areas
JOIN area_availables ON areas.id = area_availables.area_id
WHERE area_availables.start_at < ?
AND area_availables.end_at > ?
AND event_tab IN (1, 2)
ORDER BY area_availables.priority ASC
), '[]'),
'z_battles_stages', json('[]'),
'eventkagi_events', COALESCE((
SELECT json(json_object(
'minibannerimage', areas.banner_image_path || areas.id || '.png',
WHERE quests.area_id = areas.id
)) AS event_data
AND event_tab = 3
), json('[]')),
'eventkagi_z_battle_stages', json('[]')
) AS Result;
'announcement', (
'id', announcements.id,
'category', announcements.category,
'layout_type', announcements.layout_type,
'title', announcements.title,
'banner', announcements.bannerURL,
'summary', announcements.summary,
'start_at', announcements.start_at,
'new_appear_at', announcements.new_appear_at,
'is_new', CASE

'layout_type', announcement_bodies.layout_type,
'image', announcement_bodies.image,
'description', announcement_bodies.description
FROM announcement_bodies
WHERE announcement_bodies.announcement_id = announcements.id
'announcement_status', 'available'
FROM announcements
WHERE announcements.id = ?
'announcement_tab_id', 1,
'announcement_tabs', COALESCE((
'id', announcement_tabs.id,

'announcement_tab_id', announcements.announcement_tab_id
), json('[]'))

SELECT
    c.id,
    c.potential_board_id,
    c.skill_lv_max,
    c.rarity,
    c.optimal_awakening_grow_type,
    c.passive_skill_set_id,
    c.link_skill1_id,
    c.link_skill2_id,
    c.link_skill3_id,
    c.link_skill4_id,
    c.link_skill5_id,
    c.link_skill6_id,
    c.link_skill7_id,
    oag.step AS oag_step,
    oag.skill_lv_max AS oag_skill_lv_max
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT o1.*
    FROM optimal_awakening_growths o1
    JOIN (
        SELECT optimal_awakening_grow_type, MAX(step) AS max_step
        FROM optimal_awakening_growths
        WHERE step IN (8, 4, 7, 3)
        GROUP BY optimal_awakening_grow_type
    ) o2 ON o1.optimal_awakening_grow_type = o2.optimal_awakening_grow_type
         AND o1.step = o2.max_step
) oag ON oag.optimal_awakening_grow_type = c.optimal_awakening_grow_type
WHERE (CAST(c.id AS TEXT) LIKE '1%1' OR CAST(c.id AS TEXT) LIKE '4%1' OR CAST(c.id AS TEXT) LIKE '4%2')
  AND LENGTH(CAST(c.id AS TEXT)) <= 9
  AND c.rarity IN (4, 5)
  AND c.lv_max > 119
  AND c.open_at < datetime('now')
  AND c.id <= 481899781
  AND c.id NOT IN (17426891)
